      Mô tả Công việc

      Job purpose

      Build, run and continuously improve the Quality, Health & Safety and Environmental management systems of Tietex Vietnam's newly established factory, so that products meet customer requirements, the workplace is safe, the factory complies with Vietnamese law, and the factory passes certification and customer audits (ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, GRS, Higg FEM, SLCP).

      Key responsibilities

       QHSE system set-up

      1.      Establish, document and maintain the QHSE management system, including the QHSE policy, objectives, procedures, SOPs, work instructions and forms.

      Lead the factory's certification to ISO 9001, and prepare for ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 according to the Company's roadmap.

      2.      Control documents and records: issue, revise, distribute and archive QHSE documents so that they are always audit-ready.

      Quality

      1.      Set up and supervise quality control for incoming materials, in-process production and finished goods; define inspection criteria and sampling plans.

      2.      Handle non-conforming products, customer complaints and returns; lead root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

      3.      Manage calibration of measuring and testing equipment, and supplier quality evaluation.

      Health & Safety / An toàn – Sức khỏe nghề nghiệp

      1.      Identify hazards and assess risks for all activities, machines and chemicals; set control measures and keep the risk register up to date.

      2.      Organize occupational safety and hygiene (OSH) training, fire prevention and fighting drills, first aid, and periodic health examinations as required by law and the Internal Labor Regulations.

      3.      Manage chemicals (SDS/MSDS, labelling, storage, spill response), personal protective equipment and permit-to-work for high-risk tasks.

      4.      Investigate and report accidents, incidents and near misses to the Group and the competent authorities; follow up corrective actions.

      Environment

      1.      Ensure compliance with environmental permits and reports, including waste classification, hazardous waste contracts, wastewater connection to the industrial zone and periodic environmental monitoring.

      2.      Monitor energy, water and waste data, and drive reduction programs.

      Customer and industry standards

      1.      Implement and maintain Global Recycled Standard (GRS) chain-of-custody, material traceability and transaction records.

      2.      Prepare and submit Higg FEM self-assessments and SLCP data collection, and coordinate their verification.

      3.      Act as the main contact for certification bodies, customer auditors and authorities during audits and inspections; close findings on schedule.

      Audits, reporting and people

      1.      Plan and lead internal audits and management reviews.

      2.      Report monthly QHSE performance to the General Manager and the Group, in English.

      3.      Recruit, train and supervise QC/HSE staff when appointed; build a QHSE culture across all departments.

      4.      Perform other tasks assigned by the General Manager.

      Authority

      1.      Stop any work, machine or process that poses an imminent risk to people, property or the environment, and report immediately to the General Manager.

      2.      Hold (quarantine) non-conforming materials or products until a disposition decision is made.

      3.      Access all areas, records and data needed for QHSE audits and investigations.

      4.      Propose disciplinary action for QHSE violations under the Internal Labor Regulations. The decision remains with the persons authorized in Article 23 of the Internal Labor Regulations

      Coordinates with

      Production, Maintenance, Warehouse, Purchasing, HR–Admin, CS, ACC …

      Workplace

      Tietex Vietnam factory, Street D3, Nhon Trach II – Loc Khang IZ, Nhon Trach Ward, Dong Nai City 

      Working time

      Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 (lunch 12:00–13:00), per the Internal Labor Regulations; may be required outside normal hours for audits, incidents, or emergencies

      Benefit:

      Salary negotiation in the range of 30- 40 M VND Gross

      13th month salary

      Meal allowance…

      Yêu Cầu Công Việc

      Eligibility / Điều kiện

      Vietnamese citizen or legally permitted to work in Vietnam /

      Education / Học vấn

      Engineering degree in Environment, Chemistry, Textiles or a related field

      Preferred / Ưu tiên Postgraduate degree

      Experience / Kinh nghiệm

      At least 5 years in a QHSE position in manufacturing

      Preferred / Ưu tiên Set-up of a new (greenfield) factory; textile or nonwoven industry

      Systems / Hệ thống

      Established and maintained ISO 9001; wrote SOPs and work instructions; passed external audits

      Preferred / Ưu tiên ISO 45001, ISO 14001

      Industry standards

      GRS, Higg FEM, SLCP

      Certificates

      ISO internal/lead auditor; OSH officer training certificate (Group 2)

      IT / Tin học

      MS Office, Internet, ERP systems

      Preferred / Ưu tiên Process engineering software

      Language

      Fluent English, spoken and written

      Skills

      Well organized; clear verbal and written communication; analytical, logical, good judgment, strong problem solving; works independently and in a team

      Preferred / Ưu tiên Training and coaching

      Commute

      Able to commute independently to Nhon Trach II IZ, Dong Nai /

      Địa điểm làm việc

      Đồng Nai
      Đường D3, KCN Nhơn Trạch II-Lộc Khang, Phú Hội, Nhơn Trạch, Đồng Nai

      Thông tin khác

      • Bằng cấp: Đại học
      • Thời gian thử việc: 2 months
      • Độ tuổi: Không giới hạn tuổi
      • Lương: Cạnh tranh
